tasks.title: Three rulings the attempt model needs (A2)
tasks.detail: The A2 survey hit three cases the spec does not cover. Answer in the note; A2's build reads them. (1) THE PEEK — tapping the grey ? on a sum reveals the answer and the round goes inert; she never answers. Is that no attempt at all, an attempt excluded like help, or an incorrect one? It decides whether a peeked stage reads as unpractised or as fine. (2) IS 'SAY IT AGAIN' HELP? The spec names dot-hints and Fred-talk only. If repeating the prompt is not help, find pages — which have no other affordance — are never help-excluded at all. (3) ABANDONMENT — she taps the X mid-page. Absent a ruling CC records nothing, on the grounds that silence is not evidence of getting it wrong; say if you want it counted. Full reasoning in docs/pet-island-runA.md, FIELD NOTES — A2.
tasks.note: 1) peeking is not rewarded - it is counted as no attempt 2) we have no fred talk set up, open a card for that. answering with a hint counts. as it takes longer, it would be picked up in the proficiency measures, but it does not hamper the reward. 3) abandoned challenges should be measured as paused and answers made so far count towards proficiency and the reward progress.

tasks.title: The other half of JT-008(3): what does a paused page PAY?
tasks.detail: Your ruling said an abandoned challenge is paused and answers made so far count towards proficiency AND the reward progress. The proficiency half is built (A2): every word she answered was recorded as it landed, and only the unfinished one is dropped. The reward half is not, because it cannot be decided without you. THE GAP, exactly. Reading pays by the PAGE, not by the word: challengePassed adds one item to readProgress when a page completes. Build and sum pages are one question each, so leaving after answering already collects (A1 kept that deliberately). A FIND page is 3 words at first and grows to 12 - so a girl who finds 11 of 12 and taps the X banks nothing at all toward the egg. That single case is the whole of the gap. Three ways it could go, and they cost very different things. (a) PRO-RATA: pay 11/12 of a page. Needs part-items in a currency A7 just re-based to whole ones, and it moves pages-per-egg, which the month-walk pins. (b) RESUME - your word was paused: the same page comes back with the 11 words still found, she finds the twelfth, the page pays in full. Nothing in the economy moves. Costs in-session round state and a change to the ported wordFind renderer, which is a parity question rather than a free one. (c) NOTHING CHANGES: readHeld already brings the same card back, so she re-reads 11 words she can already read - which is not a punishment so much as a chore. Answer in the note and the build reads it, exactly as JT-008 did.
tasks.note: we go with C) nothing changes, she does the page again. if it flags in play test, i will bring it back, but close after implementation for now.

tasks.title: Three rulings the harness needs (A3) — how much of each thing she gets
tasks.detail: The A3 survey found one thing the spec does not cover, and it turns out to be the same question twice. The harness is keyed by PATH - levelFor('sums'), levelFor('reading') - but the island has only TWO ways into a challenge and each of them covers two paths: tapping a plot could be sums or takingAway, tapping the egg could be reading (find a word) or building (make one from letters). So before the harness can pick a STAGE, something has to pick the PATH, and that is the knob that decides what she actually plays. The reading half already has an answer sitting in balance.json that nobody chose; the maths half has no answer anywhere, because taking-away has never once been dealt on the island. Worth knowing before you answer: subtraction is entirely BUILT - the generator is ported with all three levels, the sum page already paints the minus sign and marks it correctly. Nothing is missing but the choice. Full reasoning in docs/pet-island-runA.md, FIELD NOTES - A3. (1) HOW MUCH TAKING-AWAY? You hand-tick takingAway 1 next to sums 1 (that is JT-007). What share of her maths is then take-aways? The spec says draw evenly across every ticked stage, which gives a half - but the share then DRIFTS as a side effect of unrelated ticks: the day you tick sums 2 as well, subtraction quietly drops from a half to a third, because it is one stage in three rather than one in two. The alternative is a fixed ratio in balance.json, the way reading already has one, which holds still no matter what else you tick. (2) THE READING MIX - this is PB-038 and A3 forces it open, because A3 rebuilds the very line the bug lives on. balance.json says find, build, build, build - one find page in four. Since A7 re-based the currency she has actually been getting one in two. Nobody chose either. Which do you want: one find in four as written, one in two as played, or something else? (3) CAN A PARENT EMPTY A PATH? Untick every maths stage and tapping a plot has nothing to deal; untick reading AND building and the egg can never hatch. Two ways: refuse the last untick (the panel simply will not let you), or allow it and have the island quietly stop offering that kind of round - no error, no child-facing anything, the egg just sits there. The second is more honest to 'untick is a parent's hand, not a demotion'; the first cannot be walked into by accident. Answer in the note and the build reads it, exactly as JT-008 and JT-009 did.
